thread:
Aisha Patel: Drafting a compact manager checklist for new hires (first week, PMs). What's essential?

Liam Chen: Access list first: AD groups, GitHub teams, CI tokens, Slack channels. Raise infra tickets day 0.

Rita Gomez: Put the 30/60/90 kickoff meeting on calendar in week 1. Also a note on role success metrics.

Samir Rao: My day-by-day skeleton I use:
Day 0: HR paperwork + IT
Day 1: Team intro + product walkthrough
Day 2: Dev environment + starter ticket
Day 3: Pairing + docs deep dive
Day 4: First small async deliverable
Day 5: 1:1 recap + draft 30/60/90

Aisha Patel: Good. Also add 'who to ping' map for blockers (eng-ci, devops, security, IT-support).

Liam Chen: Include a tiny starter PR template that verifies end-to-end access (CI, review, deploy).

Rita Gomez: Manager 1:1 prompts: how do you like to onboard, immediate blockers, 30/60/90 expectations, early wins.

OnboardBot: Added 'manager-week1-template' to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/manager-week1-template :white_check_mark:

Aisha Patel: I'll assemble into a short doc: access checklist, owner map, day-by-day plan, 1:1 prompts, starter PR, 30/60/90 skeleton. Will share for review.

Liam Chen: Happy to review when it's up.

Rita Gomez: Glancing at this now, will add People Ops notes.

Samir Rao: Small suggestion: include a checklist item to verify MFA, KMS access, and dataset permissions for PMs who need analytics.

Aisha Patel: Thanks — adding that.
